name: estset_v1 frozen FP rules
frozen_before: any frac50 / SAM3 / Gemini / DINOv3 feature was computed on the 344 estset blocks and before any label-vs-signal comparison. Only label counts (TP 250 / FP 82 / PART 12 / UNS 0) were looked at.
flag_means: rule says 'FP' for the block (flag only; nothing deleted)

C.desc: same union on all sizes (score part keeps its built-in >=100 m2 condition, as build_v4 fp_flag_union_all)

D.desc: nomination = rule C (fpclean_v2 nom_score|nom_frac50|nom_sam) -> Gemini dual-scale verify -> safety rule; flagged = action == 'fp_candidate' only ('review' and 'keep' are not flagged; review counted as review load)
D.safety: if sam3_cov <= 0.02 and frac50 < 0.30 and gemini action == 'keep' -> 'review' (safety_sam0_pregate_low)

E.desc: DINOv3-SAT-L frozen features, native view, logistic-regression head trained on Cape Town labels only; flag = p_FP >= 0.5611882517854918 on area_m2 >= 100
E.head: make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(C=0.01, max_iter=5000, class_weight='balanced')) fit on ct_emb_dinov3l_sat.npz 'native' with CT labels exactly as ct_cls_transfer_v1/s2_train_eval.py (deterministic refit; the script does not persist the head)
E.threshold_source: 95% of CT true panels pass on CT grid-grouped OOF (durban_heldout_metrics.csv row CT-dinov3l_sat-native-logreg)
E.features: Durban block embedding as pregate_dino_021786_v1/feats_v1.py (native view), unchanged
E.refit_check: must reproduce dev-350 row 60/65 FP caught, 10/191 TP flagged before scoring estset

evaluation_plan.weights: manifest pi / weight; stratified (cell) Horvitz-Thompson and ratio-to-cell-area estimators; 95% CI = stratified bootstrap within cells (B=2000); certainty cells XL/L contribute no sampling variance
evaluation_plan.metrics: per rule: flagged area/count, precision (area, count), FP-area capture, true-panel area wrongly flagged (city-weighted), review load

bars.codex: real-panel area loss UB <= 1% of true-panel area; cut-area precision LB >= 0.98; FP-area capture LB >= 0.75
bars.claude: area precision LB >= 0.90 and wrongly cut TP area <= ~38,000 m2 city-wide
